title: Transaction recovery journal, schemaVersion 2 (spec 06 P4)
description: Same role and path as v1, with images by reference: each after image is the staged file the transaction publishes, each before image a hard link to the replaced file, both next to the target. Writing it costs a few hundred bytes instead of the base64 of every image. v1 stays readable and recoverable; `--journal-version 1` writes v1.

beforeBackup.description: ".<base>.<transactionId>.<index>.before" next to the target; null when beforeHash is null.

afterStage.description: ".<base>.<transactionId>.<index>.stage" next to the target; null when afterHash is null.

x-shiori-rules: beforeBackup/afterStage are exactly the names derived from the path, transaction id and target index; any other name invalidates the journal
an image is read from the target itself when it already holds that hash, else from its backup or staged file; an image found nowhere refuses only the recovery direction that needs it
the v1 rules on paths, planFile moves and third states apply unchanged
